title: O‘tgan zamon: noto‘g‘ri fe’llar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida o‘ttizga yaqin eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan noto‘g‘ri fe’lning o‘tgan shaklini to‘g‘ri aytasiz, did va didn’t bilan savol, inkor va qisqa javoblar tuzasiz hamda o‘nta noto‘g‘ri fe’l bilan qisqa hikoya aytib bera olasiz.

scenes.title: Noto‘g‘ri fe‘llar bilan tanishamiz
scenes.say: Hello again! Last time we used regular verbs with -ed. Today we learn the most common irregular verbs: went, saw, bought, ate and many more.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda muntazam fe’llarga “-ed” qo‘shib, o‘tgan zamonda gapirishni o‘rgandik: worked, played, visited. Bugun esa ingliz tilining eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan fe’llariga o‘tamiz, ya’ni “-ed” qabul qilmaydigan fe’llarga. Dars oxirida o‘ttizga yaqin noto‘g‘ri fe’lning o‘tgan shaklini bilasiz, savol va inkor gaplar tuzasiz va kichik hikoya aytib bera olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Salom yana! O‘tgan safar -ed bilan tugaydigan muntazam fe’llarni o‘rgandik. Bugun eng keng tarqalgan noto‘g‘ri fe’llarni o‘rganamiz: went, saw, bought, ate va boshqalar.

scenes.title: Noto‘g‘ri fe‘l nima?
scenes.say: Regular verbs take -ed. Irregular verbs change in a special way. Go becomes went. See becomes saw. You must learn them.
scenes.say_native: Muntazam fe’lga “-ed” qo‘shamiz va ish tamom. Noto‘g‘ri fe’l esa o‘z shaklini o‘zgartiradi: “go” — “went”, “see” — “saw”. Ularning ichida eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan fe’llar bor, shuning uchun ularni bilmasdan oddiy suhbat qurib bo‘lmaydi. Yaxshi xabar shuki, ularning ko‘pi guruhlarga bo‘linadi va guruhlab yodlash ancha oson. Fe’lning lug‘at shaklini “V1”, o‘tgan zamon shaklini “V2” deb belgilaymiz.
scenes.say_uz: Muntazam fe’llar -ed oladi. Noto‘g‘ri fe’llar maxsus tarzda o‘zgaradi. Go — went bo‘ladi. See — saw bo‘ladi. Ularni yod olish kerak.

scenes.title: O‘zbek tili bilan taqqoslash
board: went, saw, took → har biri alohida
scenes.say: In Uzbek, the past ending is always the same. In English, you must remember the special form. But it is the same for I, he, she, we and they.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida o‘tgan zamon qo‘shimchasi doim bitta: bordi, ko‘rdi, oldi, berdi. Hech qanday istisno haqida o‘ylamaysiz. Ingliz tilida esa fe’lning o‘zi o‘zgaradi va bu o‘zgarishni yodlash kerak. Lekin bir yengillik bor: bu shakl hamma shaxs uchun bir xil. “I went”, “he went”, “they went” — hammasi “went”. O‘zbekchadagi “-man, -san” kabi shaxs qo‘shimchalari ingliz tilida o‘tgan zamonda umuman yo‘q.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbek tilida o‘tgan zamon qo‘shimchasi doim bir xil. Ingliz tilida maxsus shaklni eslab qolish kerak. Lekin u I, he, she, we va they uchun bir xil.

scenes.title: Birinchi guruh: go, have, do
scenes.say: We went to the market. I had a big breakfast. She did her homework.
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim uchta fe’ldan boshlaymiz. “Go” — “went”: bordim, bordik. “Have” — “had”: bor edi, yedim, ichdim; “had breakfast” — nonushta qildim. “Do” — “did”: qildi, bajardi. Bu uchinchi fe’l juda muhim, chunki “did” keyinroq savol va inkor gaplarda yordamchi so‘z vazifasini ham bajaradi. Hozircha esda tuting: “did” ham oddiy fe’l, ham yordamchi so‘z bo‘lib kela oladi.
scenes.say_uz: Biz bozorga bordik. Men katta nonushta qildim. U uy vazifasini bajardi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi guruh: say, get, make
scenes.say: He said hello. I got a letter this morning. We made a cake.
scenes.say_native: Keyingi uchtasi: “say” — “said”, “get” — “got”, “make” — “made”. E’tibor bering, “said” yozilishi bo‘yicha “sayd” o‘qilishi kerakdek ko‘rinadi, lekin aslida “sed” deb talaffuz qilinadi. “Got” juda ko‘p ma’noda ishlatiladi: oldim, bo‘ldim, yetib keldim. Masalan, “I got a letter” — xat oldim, “I got home” — uyga yetib keldim. “Made” — yasadi, pishirdi, tayyorladi.
scenes.say_uz: U salom aytdi. Bugun ertalab xat oldim. Biz tort pishirdik.

scenes.title: Uchinchi guruh: see, come, take, give
scenes.say: I saw a film. They came late. She took a photo. He gave me a book.
scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta juda kerakli fe’l. “See” — “saw”: ko‘rdim. “Come” — “came”: keldi. “Take” — “took”: oldi, olib ketdi; “took a photo” — rasmga oldi. “Give” — “gave”: berdi. Ularning hammasida o‘zak unli harf o‘zgaradi: e dan aw ga, o dan a ga, a dan oo ga, i dan a ga. Shuning uchun ularni qisqa gaplar ichida yodlash qulay: bir gap, bir fe’l.
scenes.say_uz: Men film ko‘rdim. Ular kech kelishdi. U rasmga oldi. U menga kitob berdi.

scenes.title: Kecha nima bo‘ldi
board: I made tea and took a shower.
Then I saw my neighbour and said hello.
scenes.say: Yesterday I got up early. I made tea and took a shower. Then I saw my neighbour and said hello. After that, I came to work and gave him the report.
scenes.say_native: Endi bu fe’llarni bir hikoya ichida eshiting. Kecha men erta turdim, choy damladim, dush qabul qildim. Keyin qo‘shnimni ko‘rdim va salom berdim. Ishga keldim va hisobotni topshirdim. E’tibor bering: hikoyada hamma fe’llar o‘tgan zamonda, lekin shakllari har xil. Mana shunday kichik hikoyalar fe’lni gap ichida eslab qolishga yordam beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha erta turdim. Choy damladim va dush qabul qildim. Keyin qo‘shnimni ko‘rdim va salom berdim. So‘ng ishga keldim va unga hisobotni berdim.

scenes.title: Muntazam deb o‘ylab qo‘yish
board: ✗ I seen him. / I done it.
✓ I saw him. / I did it.
scenes.say: Not goed, but went. Not taked, but took. Not I seen, but I saw. Not I done it, but I did it.
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: noto‘g‘ri fe’lga ham “-ed” qo‘shib yuborish: “goed”, “haved”, “taked”. Bunday so‘z ingliz tilida yo‘q. Ikkinchi xato ingliz tilini ona tili qilgan odamlar ham ba’zan qiladi: “I seen him” yoki “I done it”. Yozma va to‘g‘ri nutqda “I saw him” va “I did it” deyiladi. Chunki “seen” va “done” boshqa shakl bo‘lib, uni yordamchi fe’l bilan keyingi darslarda o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Goed emas, went. Taked emas, took. I seen emas, I saw. I done it emas, I did it.

scenes.title: Shaklni toping
scenes.say: Give the past form: go. have. see. take. come. make.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Oltita fe’lning o‘tgan zamon shaklini ayting: go, have, see, take, come, make. Har bir fe’ldan keyin biroz to‘xtab, baland ovozda javob bering. Agar bilmasangiz, oldingi sahnalarni eslang. Shoshilmang, har bir shaklni aniq aytishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan zamon shaklini ayting: go. have. see. take. come. make.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: go → went   have → had   see → saw
take → took   come → came   make → made
scenes.say: Go, went. Have, had. See, saw. Take, took. Come, came. Make, made.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: go — went, have — had, see — saw, take — took, come — came, make — made. Agar to‘rttasidan ko‘pini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi. Xatolar bo‘lsa, ularni daftarga alohida yozib qo‘ying. Xato qilgan fe’llar sizning shaxsiy ro‘yxatingiz bo‘ladi va aynan shularni ko‘proq takrorlash kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Go, went. Have, had. See, saw. Take, took. Come, came. Make, made.

scenes.title: Guruh: -ought tugaydiganlar
scenes.say: I bought a new phone. She brought some water. We thought it was cheap.
scenes.say_native: Endi yodlash uchun juda qulay guruh: “-ought” bilan tugaydigan fe’llar. “Buy” — “bought”, “bring” — “brought”, “think” — “thought”. Uchalasida ham oxiri bir xil o‘qiladi: uzun “o‘” tovushi, transkripsiyada /ɔː/, so‘ng “t”. Ingliz tilida bu yozuv “gh” ni o‘qimaydi. Yana ikkita fe’l shu guruhga yaqin: “catch” — “caught” va “teach” — “taught”. Ular ham /ɔː/ bilan tugaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Men yangi telefon sotib oldim. U suv olib keldi. Biz uni arzon deb o‘yladik.

scenes.title: Guruh: bir xil qoladiganlar

examples.t: I put my keys on the table.
I read that book last year.
examples.uz: Men bu kitobni o‘tgan yili o‘qigandim.

scenes.say: I put my keys on the table. She cut the bread. I read that book last year.
scenes.say_native: Ba’zi fe’llar o‘tgan zamonda umuman o‘zgarmaydi: “put”, “cut”, “hit”, “let”, “shut”. Bu eng oson guruh. “Read” ham yozuvda o‘zgarmaydi, lekin talaffuzi o‘zgaradi. Hozirgi zamonda uzun “riid”, o‘tgan zamonda esa “red” deb o‘qiladi, ya’ni rang nomi “red” kabi. Qaysi zamon ekanini gapning mazmunidan va vaqt so‘zlaridan, masalan “last year” dan bilib olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Kalitlarimni stol ustiga qo‘ydim. U nonni kesdi. Bu kitobni o‘tgan yili o‘qiganman.

scenes.title: Guruh: i dan a ga

examples.t: I drank two cups of tea.

scenes.say: I drank two cups of tea. The film began at eight. We ate fish for dinner.
scenes.say_native: Keyingi guruhda unli “i” o‘tgan zamonda “a” ga almashadi: “drink” — “drank”, “begin” — “began”, “swim” — “swam”, “sing” — “sang”. Ularga “eat” — “ate” ni ham qo‘shamiz, garchi u biroz boshqacha bo‘lsa ham. Britaniya talaffuzida “ate” ko‘pincha “et” deb o‘qiladi, Amerikada esa “eyt”. Ikkalasini ham to‘g‘ri deb qabul qiling, asosiysi, “eated” demaslik.
scenes.say_uz: Men ikki piyola choy ichdim. Film soat sakkizda boshlandi. Kechki ovqatga baliq yedik.

scenes.title: Guruh: oxirida -t
scenes.say: I slept for nine hours. She felt tired. We left at six. We met at the station.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir foydali guruh: fe’l oxiriga “-t” keladi, ba’zan o‘zakdagi unli qisqaradi. “Sleep” — “slept”, “keep” — “kept”, “feel” — “felt”, “leave” — “left”, “send” — “sent”, “spend” — “spent”, “meet” — “met”. Ko‘rib turibsiz, ularning hammasi “-t” bilan tugaydi. Bunday qoidani bilsangiz, yetti fe’lni yettita alohida so‘z sifatida emas, bitta naqsh sifatida eslab qolasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Men to‘qqiz soat uxladim. U o‘zini charchagan his qildi. Biz oltida chiqib ketdik. Biz bekatda uchrashdik.

scenes.title: Guruh: -o- paydo bo‘ladi
scenes.say: She wrote an email. He drove to Samarkand. We spoke English. I forgot my umbrella.
scenes.say_native: Bu guruhda o‘tgan zamon shaklida “o” harfi paydo bo‘ladi: “write” — “wrote”, “drive” — “drove”, “speak” — “spoke”, “wear” — “wore”, “forget” — “forgot”. Shaklan juda o‘xshash bo‘lgani uchun ularni bir qatorda takrorlang. Masalan, “write, wrote”, “drive, drove”, “speak, spoke”. Ritm bilan aytsangiz, til o‘rganib qoladi.
scenes.say_uz: U elektron xat yozdi. U Samarqandga mashinada bordi. Biz inglizcha gaplashdik. Men soyabonimni unutdim.

scenes.title: Qolgan foydali fe’llar
board: stand → stood   run → ran   know → knew
scenes.say: He sold his old car. I found my keys. They won the match. She paid in cash.
scenes.say_native: Qolgan muhim fe’llarni ham ko‘rib chiqamiz: “sell” — “sold”, “tell” — “told”, “find” — “found”, “win” — “won”, “pay” — “paid”, “sit” — “sat”, “stand” — “stood”, “run” — “ran”, “know” — “knew”. Bularni bitta qoidaga solib bo‘lmaydi, shuning uchun ularni oz-ozdan, kuniga beshtadan yodlang. Hozirgacha bilganlaringizni sanasak, o‘ttizdan ortiq fe’l bo‘ldi. Bu juda katta natija.
scenes.say_uz: U eski mashinasini sotdi. Men kalitlarimni topdim. Ular o‘yinda g‘alaba qozonishdi. U naqd pul bilan to‘ladi.

scenes.title: Bringed, buyed, thinked
scenes.say: Not bringed, but brought. Not buyed, but bought. Not thinked, but thought. Not losed, but lost.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir xil xato: tanish qoidani noto‘g‘ri joyda qo‘llash. O‘quvchilar “buyed”, “bringed”, “thinked” va “losed” deydi. Bu so‘zlar ingliz tilida mavjud emas. Esda tuting: ingliz tilida fe’lga “-ed” qo‘shishdan oldin o‘zingizdan so‘rang: bu ro‘yxatdagi fe’lmi? Agar ha bo‘lsa, maxsus shaklni ishlating. Va yana bir yodlash maslahati: “lose” — “lost”, “loose” esa butunlay boshqa so‘z, ya’ni bo‘sh, keng.
scenes.say_uz: Bringed emas, brought. Buyed emas, bought. Thinked emas, thought. Losed emas, lost.

scenes.title: Qaysi shakl to‘g‘ri?
scenes.say: Complete: I bought or buyed a coffee? She wrote or writed a letter? We meet or met at the cafe? He lose or lost the money?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchi: I — buy fe’lining o‘tgan shakli — a coffee. Ikkinchi: she — write — a long letter. Uchinchi: we — meet — at the cafe. To‘rtinchi: he — lose — the money. Har bir gapni to‘liq baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: To‘ldiring: I bought yoki buyed? She wrote yoki writed? We meet yoki met? He lose yoki lost?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: I bought a coffee. She wrote a long letter. We met at the cafe. He lost the money.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: bought, wrote, met, lost. Birinchi gap “-ought” guruhidan, ikkinchisi “-o-” guruhidan, uchinchisi “-t” guruhidan. To‘rtinchisi ham yakuniy “-t” bilan tugaydi, lekin unli tovush qisqaradi. Ko‘rdingizmi, guruhni bilsangiz, fe’lni topish tezlashadi. Endi inkor va savol gaplarga o‘tamiz, chunki aynan shu yerda eng ko‘p xato qilinadi.
scenes.say_uz: I bought a coffee. She wrote a long letter. We met at the cafe. He lost the money.

scenes.title: Yodlash usullari
scenes.say: Learn verbs in groups. Learn five a day. Make sentences about your life. Say them aloud.
scenes.say_native: Yodlash uchun to‘rtta amaliy usul. Birinchi, fe’llarni guruhlarga bo‘lib o‘rganing, bugungi darsdagidek. Ikkinchi, kuniga beshtadan oshirmang, lekin har kuni takrorlang. Uchinchi, har bir fe’l uchun o‘z hayotingizdan gap tuzing: “I bought bread this morning.” Shaxsiy gap miyada uzoq saqlanadi. To‘rtinchi, ovoz chiqarib ayting, chunki talaffuz va shakl birga yodlanadi. Ro‘yxatni jim o‘qish eng kam samara beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Fe’llarni guruhlab o‘rganing. Kuniga beshtadan yodlang. O‘z hayotingiz haqida gap tuzing. Ularni ovoz chiqarib ayting.

scenes.title: O‘tgan zamonda inkor: didn’t
board: I / he / she / we / they + didn’t + V1
I didn’t go.   She didn’t see it.
scenes.say: I didn't go to school. He didn't buy a car. We didn't eat meat.
scenes.say_native: Inkor gap juda oson: “didn’t” va fe’lning oddiy, lug‘at shakli. “I didn’t go” — men bormadim. “He didn’t buy a car” — u mashina sotib olmadi. Eng muhim qoida: “didn’t” o‘tgan zamon belgisini o‘zi olib bo‘ldi, shuning uchun asosiy fe’l o‘tgan zamonga qaytmaydi. “Went” emas, “go”; “bought” emas, “buy”. Bu o‘zbekchadagi “bormadi” bilan o‘xshash: “-ma-” inkor bildiradi, zamon ko‘rsatkichi esa alohida.
scenes.say_uz: Men maktabga bormadim. U mashina sotib olmadi. Biz go‘sht yemadik.

scenes.title: Didn’t went — katta xato
scenes.say: Not I didn't went, but I didn't go. Not she didn't bought, but she didn't buy.
scenes.say_native: Mana eng keng tarqalgan xato: “I didn’t went”. O‘quvchi o‘ylaydi: o‘tgan zamon, demak “went” kerak. Aslida o‘tgan zamon ma’nosini “didn’t” beradi, fe’l esa oddiy qoladi. Qoida: “did” yoki “didn’t” bor joyda asosiy fe’l hamisha lug‘at shaklida turadi. Ikkita o‘tgan zamon belgisi bir gapda bo‘lmaydi. Buni quloqqa singdirish uchun “didn’t go, didn’t buy, didn’t eat” ni bir necha marta takrorlang.
scenes.say_uz: I didn't went emas, I didn't go. She didn't bought emas, she didn't buy.

scenes.title: Savol: Did + ega + V1
board: Did + I / you / he / she / we / they + V1 ?
Did you go to the party?
scenes.say: Did you see the film? Did he come on time? Did they win?
scenes.say_native: Savol gap tuzish uchun “did” ni gapning boshiga qo‘yamiz, keyin ega, keyin fe’lning lug‘at shakli. “Did you see the film?” — filmni ko‘rdingizmi? O‘zbek tilida savolni “-mi” yuklamasi bilan beramiz, ingliz tilida esa yordamchi so‘z “did” ni oldinga chiqaramiz. Bu yerda ham fe’l oddiy shaklda qoladi: “Did you saw” emas, “Did you see”. Savolning ohangi oxirida ko‘tariladi.
scenes.say_uz: Filmni ko‘rdingizmi? U vaqtida keldimi? Ular g‘alaba qozonishdimi?

scenes.title: Did you went?
scenes.say: Did you go there? Not did you went. What did you buy? Not what did you bought.
scenes.say_native: Savolda ham xuddi shu xato bor: “Did you went there?” noto‘g‘ri. To‘g‘risi “Did you go there?”. Xuddi shuningdek, “What did you bought?” emas, “What did you buy?”. Qoida bitta: savol ham, inkor ham “did” bilan tuziladi, “did” esa o‘tgan zamonni o‘zi ko‘taradi. Fe’l esa lug‘at shaklida qoladi. Mana shuni mustahkam o‘zlashtirsangiz, o‘tgan zamonning eng katta qiyinchiligidan o‘tib ketasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Did you go there? Did you went emas. What did you buy? What did you bought emas.

scenes.title: Qisqa javoblar
board: Yes, I did.   /   No, I didn’t.
Did you eat? — Yes, I did.
Did he call? — No, he didn’t.

examples.t: Did you sleep well? Yes, I did.
Did she come? No, she didn't.

scenes.say: Did you sleep well? Yes, I did. Did she come? No, she didn't.
scenes.say_native: Ha-yo‘q savollarga qisqa javob beriladi: “Yes, I did” yoki “No, I didn’t”. Bu yerda asosiy fe’l umuman takrorlanmaydi: “Yes, I slept” emas, “Yes, I did”. Shaxs savolga qarab o‘zgaradi: “Did she come?” — “No, she didn’t”; “Did they win?” — “Yes, they did”. O‘zbek tilida “ha, uxladim” deymiz, ingliz tilida esa yordamchi so‘z qaytariladi. Bu odatiy, tabiiy muloqot shakli.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi uxladingizmi? Ha, uxladim. U keldimi? Yo‘q, kelmadi.

scenes.title: Qisqa javob bering
scenes.say: Answer with a short answer. Did you drink tea today? Did you read a book? Did your friend call you? Did you run yesterday?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Mana to‘rtta savol. Birinchi va uchinchisiga ijobiy qisqa javob bering, ikkinchi va to‘rtinchisiga inkor shaklda. Ya’ni “Yes, I did” yoki “No, I didn’t” va uchinchi savolda ega boshqa: do‘stingiz, demak “he” yoki “she”. Ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa javob bering. Bugun choy ichdingizmi? Kitob o‘qidingizmi? Do‘stingiz sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qildimi? Kecha yugurdingizmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Yes, I did. No, I didn't. Yes, he did. No, I didn't.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchisiga “Yes, I did”, ikkinchisiga “No, I didn’t”, uchinchisiga “Yes, he did” yoki “Yes, she did”, to‘rtinchisiga “No, I didn’t”. Albatta, haqiqiy javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi shakl: “did” yoki “didn’t” ni ishlatish, fe’lni qaytarmaslik. Agar xohlasangiz, javobga bir gap qo‘shing: “No, I didn’t. I was busy.”
scenes.say_uz: Ha, ichdim. Yo‘q, o‘qimadim. Ha, qo‘ng‘iroq qildi. Yo‘q, yugurmadim.

scenes.title: Wh- savollar
scenes.say: What did you buy? Where did he go? Why did you leave? How did they get home?
scenes.say_native: Ma’lumot so‘raydigan savollarda so‘roq so‘zi boshida turadi: what, where, when, why, how. Undan keyin xuddi shunday tartib: “did”, ega, lug‘at shaklidagi fe’l. “What did you buy?” — nima sotib oldingiz? “Where did he go?” — u qayerga bordi? O‘zbek tilida so‘roq so‘zi odatda gap o‘rtasida turadi: “Siz nima oldingiz?” Ingliz tilida esa u doim boshida bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Nima sotib oldingiz? U qayerga bordi? Nega ketdingiz? Ular uyga qanday yetib borishdi?

scenes.title: Dialog 1: Hafta oxiri
board: A: What did you do at the weekend?
B: I went to the market and bought fish.
B: Yes, I did. We ate it with rice.
scenes.say: What did you do at the weekend? I went to the market and bought some fish. Did you cook it? Yes, I did. We ate it with rice and my brother made a salad. And you? I stayed at home. I slept a lot and read a book.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki do‘st dam olish kunlari haqida gaplashmoqda. Savollar “did” bilan tuzilgan, javoblarda esa noto‘g‘ri fe’llar: went, bought, ate, made, slept. Tinglab, quyidagilarni aniqlang: bozorga kim bordi, nima sotib oldi va ikkinchi suhbatdosh dam olish kunini qanday o‘tkazdi.
scenes.say_uz: Dam olish kunlari nima qildingiz? Bozorga bordim va baliq sotib oldim. Uni pishirdingizmi? Ha. Biz uni guruch bilan yedik, akam salat tayyorladi. O‘zingiz-chi? Uyda qoldim. Ko‘p uxladim va kitob o‘qidim.

scenes.title: Dialog 1 haqida savollar
board: 1) Where did the first speaker go?
3) What did the second speaker do?
scenes.say: Where did the first speaker go? What did he buy? What did the second speaker do at the weekend?
scenes.say_native: Tushunganingizni tekshiramiz. Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: birinchi so‘zlovchi qayerga bordi? Ikkinchi: u nima sotib oldi? Uchinchi: ikkinchi so‘zlovchi dam olish kunini qanday o‘tkazdi? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan, o‘tgan zamonda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi so‘zlovchi qayerga bordi? U nima sotib oldi? Ikkinchi so‘zlovchi dam olish kunlari nima qildi?

scenes.title: Dialog 1: javoblar
board: 3) He stayed at home, slept and read.
scenes.say: He went to the market. He bought fish. The other speaker stayed at home, slept a lot and read a book.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi do‘st bozorga bordi, baliq sotib oldi, uni pishirdi va guruch bilan yedi. Ikkinchi do‘st uyda qoldi, ko‘p uxladi va kitob o‘qidi. Ko‘rdingizmi, siz fe’llarni eshitib tushundingiz: went, bought, slept, read. Muhimi, siz javobda ham “went” va “bought” dan foydalana oldingiz, bu faol bilimning belgisi.
scenes.say_uz: U bozorga bordi. U baliq sotib oldi. Ikkinchisi uyda qoldi, ko‘p uxladi va kitob o‘qidi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: Yo‘qolgan sumka
board: B: I lost it! I left it on the bus.
A: Did you call the bus company?
B: Yes, I did, but they didn't find it.
scenes.say: Where is your bag? I lost it. I left it on the bus. Did you call the bus company? Yes, I did. They said they didn't find it. Oh no. Did you have your phone inside? Yes, I did. And my keys.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Bir kishi sumkasini yo‘qotdi. Eshiting: lost, left, said, didn’t find, did. Bu yerda ham savol va javoblarda “did” va “didn’t” qanday ishlatilishiga e’tibor bering. Ko‘ryapsizmi, kundalik hayotdagi muammolar haqida gapirishda noto‘g‘ri fe’llar juda ko‘p uchraydi.
scenes.say_uz: Sumkang qani? Uni yo‘qotdim. Avtobusda qoldirdim. Avtobus kompaniyasiga qo‘ng‘iroq qildingmi? Ha. Ular topolmadi, deyishdi. Voy. Ichida telefoning bormidi? Ha. Kalitlarim ham.

scenes.title: Dialog 2 haqida savollar
board: 1) Where did he leave the bag?
2) Did he call the bus company?
scenes.say: Where did he leave the bag? Did he call the bus company? What was inside the bag?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: sumkani qayerda qoldirdi? Ikkinchi: avtobus kompaniyasiga qo‘ng‘iroq qildimi? Uchinchi: sumka ichida nima bor edi? Birinchi va ikkinchisiga to‘liq gap bilan javob bering, uchinchisiga esa ikkita narsani ayting.
scenes.say_uz: U sumkani qayerda qoldirdi? U avtobus kompaniyasiga qo‘ng‘iroq qildimi? Sumka ichida nima bor edi?

scenes.title: Dialog 2: javoblar
board: 1) He left it on the bus.
scenes.say: He left it on the bus. Yes, he did. His phone and his keys were inside.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: u sumkani avtobusda qoldirdi. Ha, kompaniyaga qo‘ng‘iroq qildi, lekin ular sumkani topmadi. Sumka ichida telefon va kalitlar bor edi. Yana bir eslatma: “be” fe’li ham noto‘g‘ri fe’l: “am, is” — “was”, “are” — “were”. U savol va inkorda “did” talab qilmaydi: “Was it there?” — “No, it wasn’t.”
scenes.say_uz: U uni avtobusda qoldirdi. Ha, qo‘ng‘iroq qildi. Ichida telefoni va kalitlari bor edi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: said, bought, read
scenes.say: She said she bought it. I thought you read it. Did you see it? Didja see it?
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzda xatolar ko‘p. “Said” — “sed”, “sayd” emas. “Bought” va “thought” — uzun “o‘” bilan, oxirida aniq “t”, birinchisi “b” bilan, ikkinchisi tilni tishlar orasiga qo‘yib aytiladigan “th” bilan boshlanadi. “Read” o‘tgan zamonda “red”. Va tez nutqda “did you” birlashib “didja” kabi eshitiladi. Bu normal, siz uni tanib olishingiz kerak, o‘zingiz sekin, aniq aytsangiz ham bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: U uni sotib olganini aytdi. Men sen uni o‘qigansan deb o‘yladim. Uni ko‘rdingmi?

scenes.title: Xatoni tuzating
scenes.say: Correct the mistakes. I didn't saw him. Did you went to Tashkent? She buyed a dress. What did he said?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir gapda xato bor. Uni toping va to‘g‘ri gapni ayting. Birinchi: I didn’t saw him. Ikkinchi: Did you went to Tashkent? Uchinchi: She buyed a dress. To‘rtinchi: What did he said? Har bir xatoning sababini ham o‘ylab ko‘ring.
scenes.say_uz: Xatolarni tuzating. Men uni ko‘rmadim. Toshkentga bordingizmi? U ko‘ylak sotib oldi. U nima dedi?

scenes.title: Xatolar tuzatilishi
scenes.say: I didn't see him. Did you go to Tashkent? She bought a dress. What did he say?
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri variantlar: birinchi, “I didn’t see him”, chunki “didn’t” dan keyin lug‘at shakli. Ikkinchi, “Did you go to Tashkent?”. Uchinchi, “She bought a dress”, bu yerda “did” yo‘q, shuning uchun noto‘g‘ri fe’lning o‘tgan shakli ishlatiladi. To‘rtinchi, “What did he say?”. Ko‘rdingizmi, uchta xato bir sababdan: “did” bor joyda fe’l oddiy bo‘ladi, “did” yo‘q joyda esa o‘tgan shakl.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni ko‘rmadim. Toshkentga bordingizmi? U ko‘ylak sotib oldi. U nima dedi?

scenes.title: Savol tuzing
scenes.say: Make questions. You, eat, breakfast. Where, he, go. What, they, buy. She, sleep, well.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. So‘zlardan o‘tgan zamonda savol tuzing. Birinchi: you, eat, breakfast. Ikkinchi: where, he, go. Uchinchi: what, they, buy. To‘rtinchi: she, sleep, well. Esda tuting: “did”, ega, lug‘at shaklidagi fe’l.
scenes.say_uz: Savol tuzing. Siz, yemoq, nonushta. Qayerga, u, bormoq. Nima, ular, sotib olmoq. U, uxlamoq, yaxshi.

scenes.title: Savollar javobi
scenes.say: Did you eat breakfast? Where did he go? What did they buy? Did she sleep well?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “Did you eat breakfast?”, “Where did he go?”, “What did they buy?”, “Did she sleep well?”. Birinchi va to‘rtinchi savol ha-yo‘q savol, ikkinchisi va uchinchisi so‘roq so‘zi bilan. Fe’llar hammasida lug‘at shaklida. Agar to‘g‘ri tuzgan bo‘lsangiz, tabriklayman: bu o‘tgan zamonning savol tuzilmasini egallaganingizdan darak beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Nonushta qildingizmi? U qayerga bordi? Ular nima sotib olishdi? U yaxshi uxladimi?

scenes.title: Gapirish: hikoya tuzing
board: 10 ta fe’l: go, see, buy, eat, meet, take, have, say, give, come
scenes.say: Now tell a short story about yesterday. Use ten irregular verbs. Start with: Yesterday I went to...
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘z hikoyangizni aytib bering. Kecha nima qilganingiz haqida gapiring va kamida o‘nta noto‘g‘ri fe’l ishlating. Yordam uchun taxtadagi fe’llardan foydalaning: go, see, buy, eat, meet, take, have, say, give, come. Boshlanishi: “Yesterday I went to…”. Hozir vaqt beraman, gapiring.
scenes.say_uz: Endi kecha haqida qisqa hikoya aytib bering. O‘nta noto‘g‘ri fe’l ishlating. Boshlang: Yesterday I went to...

scenes.title: Namuna hikoya
board: Yesterday I went to the market.
I bought bread and met my friend.
We had coffee and I came home at six.
scenes.say: Yesterday I got up early and went to the market. I bought bread and fish. I met my friend Ali there. We had coffee and he told me a funny story. I came home at six, made dinner and ate with my family. I slept well.
scenes.say_native: Namuna hikoya: kecha erta turdim va bozorga bordim. Non va baliq sotib oldim. U yerda do‘stim Alini uchratdim. Birga kofe ichdik va u menga kulgili voqeani aytib berdi. Oltida uyga keldim, kechki ovqat tayyorladim va oila bilan yedim. Yaxshi uxladim. Bu hikoyada o‘nta noto‘g‘ri fe’l bor. Siz hammasini topa oldingizmi? Agar kam bo‘lsa, hikoyani qayta aytib, yana fe’l qo‘shing.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha erta turib bozorga bordim. Non va baliq sotib oldim. U yerda do‘stim Alini uchratdim. Kofe ichdik va u menga kulgili hikoya aytdi. Oltida uyga keldim, kechki ovqat tayyorlab, oila bilan yedim. Yaxshi uxladim.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: V1 → V2: go → went, buy → bought
Did you…? Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
scenes.say: Great work! You learned thirty irregular verbs, and now you can make questions and negatives in the past.
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Noto‘g‘ri fe’llar “-ed” olmaydi, ularning o‘tgan shakllarini yodlash kerak. Ularni guruhlarga bo‘ldik: “-ought”, bir xil qoladiganlar, “i” dan “a” ga, “-t” bilan tugaydiganlar va “o” paydo bo‘ladiganlar. Inkor — “didn’t” va lug‘at shakli. Savol — “did”, ega, lug‘at shakli. Qisqa javob — “Yes, I did” yoki “No, I didn’t”. Eng katta xato: “didn’t went”. Buni endi bilasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Barakalla! Siz o‘ttizta noto‘g‘ri fe’lni o‘rgandingiz, endi o‘tgan zamonda savol va inkor tuza olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
scenes.say: Your homework is to tell a short story with ten irregular verbs. See you next time!
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: o‘n dona noto‘g‘ri fe’lni ishlatib, qisqa hikoya aytib bering. Hikoya sakkiz-o‘n gapdan iborat bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida o‘nta turli noto‘g‘ri fe’l to‘g‘ri shaklda, kamida bitta inkor gap “didn’t” bilan va bitta savol “did” bilan bo‘lsin. Ovoz chiqarib ayting va yozib oling. Keyingi darsda o‘tgan dam olish haqida hikoya qilishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: o‘nta noto‘g‘ri fe’l bilan qisqa hikoya aytib bering. Ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: O‘nta noto‘g‘ri fe’l ishlatib, qisqa hikoya aytib bering (8–10 gap). Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘nta turli noto‘g‘ri fe’l to‘g‘ri shaklda, kamida bitta didn’t bilan inkor va bitta did bilan savol bo‘lsin.

options: I go to the shop yesterday.
quiz.why_uz: Go ning o‘tgan shakli — went. Goed degan so‘z yo‘q.
Buy — bought. Brought esa bring ning o‘tgan shakli.
Didn't dan keyin fe’l lug‘at shaklida: didn't go.
Did dan keyin lug‘at shakli: Did you see him?

quiz.q: Which verb stays the same in the past?
quiz.why_uz: Put — put. Come — came, take — took, write — wrote.
Qisqa javobda yordamchi so‘z qaytariladi: Yes, she did.
Think — thought. Taught esa teach ning o‘tgan shakli.
Savolda did dan keyin lug‘at shakli: Where did he go?
Read o‘tgan zamonda yozilishi o‘zgarmaydi, talaffuzi esa /red/.
